verses.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O YHWH, do not rebuke me in Your wrath and chastise me in Your fury.

segments.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O YHWH, do not rebuke me in Your wrath and chastise me in Your fury.

verses.text: For Your arrows descend into me, and Your hand comes down on me.

segments.text: For Your arrows descend into me, and Your hand comes down on me.

verses.text: No soundness [is] in my flesh before the face of Your anger; no peace [is] in my bones before the face of my sin.

segments.text: No soundness [is] in my flesh before the face of Your anger; no peace [is] in my bones before the face of my sin.

verses.text: For my iniquities have passed over my head; like a heavy burden, they are heavy for me.

segments.text: For my iniquities have passed over my head; like a heavy burden, they are heavy for me.

verses.text: My wounds are foul and festering, before the face of my foolishness.

segments.text: My wounds are foul and festering, before the face of my foolishness.

verses.text: I am bent, I am bowed down even to excess; all the day I go about mourning.

segments.text: I am bent, I am bowed down even to excess; all the day I go about mourning.

verses.text: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

segments.text: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.text: I am numb and crushed, even to excess; I roar from the groaning of my heart.

segments.text: I am numb and crushed, even to excess; I roar from the groaning of my heart.

verses.text: O Lord, all my desire [is] before You, and my groaning is not hidden from You.

segments.text: O Lord, all my desire [is] before You, and my groaning is not hidden from You.

verses.text: My heart pounds, my strength has forsaken me, and the light of my eyes—even they [are] not with me.

segments.text: My heart pounds, my strength has forsaken me, and the light of my eyes—even they [are] not with me.

verses.text: My beloved and my friends stand away from my plague; my neighbors stand far off.

segments.text: My beloved and my friends stand away from my plague; my neighbors stand far off.

verses.text: And those seeking my soul lay snares, and those searching out my harm speak; they ponder destruction and treachery all the day.

segments.text: And those seeking my soul lay snares, and those searching out my harm speak; they ponder destruction and treachery all the day.

verses.text: And I [am] like a deaf one [who] does not hear and like a mute one [who] does not open his mouth.

segments.text: And I [am] like a deaf one [who] does not hear and like a mute one [who] does not open his mouth.

verses.text: And I am like a man who is not hearing, and in his mouth [are] no rebukes,

segments.text: And I am like a man who is not hearing, and in his mouth [are] no rebukes,

verses.text: because for You, O YHWH, I have waited; You will answer, O Lord my God.

segments.text: because for You, O YHWH, I have waited; You will answer, O Lord my God.

verses.text: For I said, “Lest they rejoice over me; in the slipping of my foot they magnify themselves against me.”

segments.text: For I said, “Lest they rejoice over me; in the slipping of my foot they magnify themselves against me.”

verses.text: For I am ready to fall, and my sorrow [is] before me continually.

segments.text: For I am ready to fall, and my sorrow [is] before me continually.

verses.text: For I declare my iniquity; I am anxious over my sin.

segments.text: For I declare my iniquity; I am anxious over my sin.

verses.text: And my enemies without cause are many, and those hating me without cause have been multiplied.

segments.text: And my enemies without cause are many, and those hating me without cause have been multiplied.

verses.text: And those repaying evil for good, they oppose me, because of my pursuing good.

segments.text: And those repaying evil for good, they oppose me, because of my pursuing good.

verses.text: Do not forsake me, O YHWH; O my God, do not be far from me!

segments.text: Do not forsake me, O YHWH; O my God, do not be far from me!

verses.text: Hurry to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

segments.text: Hurry to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
